title: The bird on the corn, first
logline: September 11, 2022: the corn on Gully's counter the day before the twenty-fifth, and the bird on the tray's rim for the first time, three years before the page that thought it was the first. The book prints this one; the note corrects the other.

panels.composition: Gully's counter with a paper tray of corn beside the end stool and the small rainbow bird standing on the tray's rim, the corkboard above, no one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paper tray of buttered corn on a shop counter beside an empty end stool with a small rainbow bird standing on the tray's rim, a crowded corkboard above, no people, no words
image.notes: Earlier than ro_2025-09-14; that page's 'only joke' is the second time.
